title: Display name according to station code
goal: uses switch to convert the three station codes into readable names and handle unknown codes.
summary: switch matches cases with strict equality. The hit branch can use return to directly return the result. If no match is found, it will go to default.
tasks: completes stationName(code), the parameter is a string, use switch to select the result by code.
code S returns "sewing table", C returns "cutting table", and B returns "binding table".
returns "Unknown workstation" in default, which is used for unlisted codenames such as empty strings and lowercase letters.

example.note: audio list returns the corresponding tag according to the file extension. Unmatched extensions are collectively classified as "other formats".

hint: If C does not match, check case case. A strict match would treat C and c as two different strings.
